names.aliases.back: Hebrew, ivrit, hebrew, iw, new Hebrew, modern hebrew, israeli hebrew, Israel, israel, hebräisch (German word), he-il

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm on the line. You can talk.
call.speech.im_here.note: Doubt (accepted): drops "I can hear you" (gender-neutral wording keeps only 'I'm on the line, go ahead').

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I'll need to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, before you hang up, I have one more question.
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Avoids "רגע" because it is a banned stalling word.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one moment", "a second", "a minute", "let me check" (masc.), "let me check" (fem.), "I'm checking" (masc.), "I'm checking" (fem.), "wait" (masc.), "wait" (fem.)

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you dialed is not available right now. Try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Oh, a package? Sure, it can be left by the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, yalla bye, okay bye, bye bye, be hearing from you, we'll talk later, have a good day, have a good evening, Shabbat shalom, all the best. Wrap-ups: I won't keep you, I'll have to go, I'll have to leave, I'll get back to you, that's all for now, we'll be in touch. Ends: Great, thank you very much for the help, goodbye. / We've settled everything, I'll have to go, we'll talk later. / Thanks for your patience, have a good day. Not ends: The kid said bye at the door and left for the carpool, we can continue. / Have a good day to everyone, but first I want to understand the offer. / The course is called «Goodbye» and it costs a hundred shekels a month.
call.speech.closing.note: Gender-neutral wording (אצטרך, אכעב אתכם). Bare "נדבר" left out because it also appears in non-closing sentences.

notify.ap_already.back: This meeting has already been handled

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the "{}" that was set earlier is still in your calendar. Delete it yourselves.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: The call was identified as a sales call, so the meeting set during it was cancelled: {}

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same SMS message is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: it's not possible to send an SMS to this number, so call it yourselves

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} in the end doesn't work out for me. Can we find another time?
notify.ap_sms_no.note: Written without gendered forms because the owner gender is unknown.

notify.ap_sms_off.back: will not be sent (the option "SMS message to the caller" is off in Settings)

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the phone app is too old for sending SMS

notify.ap_sms_timeout.back: the phone did not respond (time ran out)

notify.ap_sms_will.back: will be sent when you tap Approval or Rejection

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller did not confirm the time the AI repeated; check it with him before you answer

notify.ap_void_failed.back: "{}" from the call was cancelled, but it could not be removed from your calendar. Delete it yourselves.

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: number on the blacklist: a message was played and then the call was disconnected (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: number on the blacklist: it was rejected during the ringing (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: rejected during the ringing: was not answered (no AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was on another call and rejected it (no AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: came in during another call; the phone rejected it as busy{sim}

notify.e_subject.back: Reply to the message you left in the voicemail

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number for a call back: the task has no contact and the caller's number is empty.
notify.f_callback_no_number.note: Fixed per back-translation note. The word "החזרה" ("the return") is not clear Hebrew for "call back" (reads as returning something). English: 'No number to call back: ...'. Use "שיחה חוזרת" / "לחזור אליו בטלפון" consistently in all 5 callback strings.

notify.f_callback_send_failed.back: Could not send the call back
notify.f_callback_send_failed.note: Fixed per back-translation note. "את החזרה" ("the return") loses the meaning "call back". Should mean: 'Could not send the call back'; use "שיחה חוזרת".

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: The call back is scheduled, but the phone's control link is not connected. Make sure the phone is connected to Bageo and approve again.
notify.f_callback_waiting.note: Fixed per back-translation note. "החזרה מתוזמנת" reads as 'the return is scheduled' (return of what?). Should mean: 'The call back is scheduled, but the phone's control link is offline...'; use "שיחה חוזרת".

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The call-back number was not found on the whitelist. Add it (or a prefix that ends with *) in Settings and approve again.
notify.f_callback_whitelist.note: Fixed per back-translation note. "מספר החזרה" ("return number") is unclear for "call-back number". Should mean: 'The call-back number is not on the allowed list...'; use "שיחה חוזרת".

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task sends an email but has no address for a reply. Add the contact from the transcript or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail was not set up. Enter in Settings the Gmail address and the app password and approve again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: Could not pass the task to OpenClaw: {} (check in Settings the URL and the token of OpenClaw)

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address doesn't look valid. Check it in Settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient's address doesn't look valid

notify.g_no_recipient.back: Not sent: there is no recipient address

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in Settings (it is never displayed).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: the AI answered and conversed; the call ended as usual (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: the AI failed to connect; the system hung up and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: the AI failed; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: private number: a refusal message was played and then the call was disconnected (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: number on the blacklist: an unavailability message was played and then the call was disconnected (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system identified a sales / fraud call ({t}); time-stalling is off, so the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system at first thought it was a sales / fraud call; a second check found a regular call and the AI went back to conversing as usual

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system identified a sales / fraud call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the line in order to waste his time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system identified a sales / fraud call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the line in order to waste his time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone dialed the owner but did not manage to reach him, and the AI told the caller that the owner will get back to him soon; the call was not considered a sales or fraud call for stalling, so the to-do task is to get back to him as soon as possible

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone dialed the owner, the owner answered and was connected to the caller, and the AI left; the call was not considered a sales or fraud call for stalling

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was urgent and the owner got a notification immediately; the call was not considered a sales or fraud call for stalling, so the to-do task is to get back to him as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked.back: Call from a number on the blacklist

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Rejected during the ringing: not answered, without AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: "{}" was played and the call was disconnected. The AI was not used.

notify.n_fit_adjusted.back: Bageo tuned the call sound by itself. Now it works.

notify.n_fit_failed_title.back: A problem with the call sound

notify.n_fit_problem.back: There is a problem with the call sound and all settings were tried. See “First use on a new phone” in the guide.

notify.n_fit_test_body.back: This phone has not been checked yet. Call it from another phone and talk to the AI for about 20 seconds. Then Bageo will tune the call sound by itself.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: check the call sound

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot send the AI's voice to calls.

notify.n_repeat_body.back: More calls from {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.

notify.n_seconds.note: Abbreviation שנ' for seconds; check that it is common enough.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI did not connect; the system hung up]

console.f_notify_lang.back: Language of the notifications and summaries

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries that you read. This does not change the language in which the AI talks with callers.

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing was set: every call starts in the language chosen above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name by which callers address you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Additional names by which callers call you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a nickname and the like. One per line, up to 10. The AI will know they mean you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without committing to anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a personal key on the Google AI Studio site

console.f_model_h.back: The model with which the AI talks. There is almost no need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three example sentences in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and disconnected immediately. To let the phone ring as usual, use "Switching to a regular phone" on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings a bit before answering, like a real person. 0 = immediate answer.

console.f_normal_max.back: Maximum length of a regular call

console.f_prewarm.back: Preparing the AI while the phone rings

console.f_unknown_h.back: Active: callers from an anonymous number are also answered by the AI. Off: a short unavailability message is played to them and the call is disconnected.

console.f_barge.back: Allowing the caller to cut in

console.f_vad.back: Letting Gemini decide when the caller has finished talking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: the decision is made by volume alone.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_ph.back: For example for deliveries: please leave the package at the reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet ambient sound behind the AI's voice, so that it sounds like a real person answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when it is clear that the caller is trying to sell something or commit fraud.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and keeps asking for details to waste their time. It gives out no information and agrees to nothing. Off: it politely refuses and disconnects.

console.f_stall_max.back: Maximum length of such a call

console.f_stall_max_h.back: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as in regular calls

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in instruction is used

console.n_empty.back: There are no notification channels yet. Add one to receive call summaries to your phone.

console.mcp_calls_h.back: "Ask me first" requires a chat that accepts commands.

console.mcp_errands.back: Maximum number of AI calls per hour

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, for example https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.n_test_ok.back: Sent. Check that the message arrived.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its Token. Chat ID: the bot @userinfobot will tell you yours; for a group use the group ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot one message so that it can write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a Webhook address (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot's Token with the channel ID; one of them is enough. For a private message, enter your own ID instead of the channel ID. Chat commands: fill in the bot's Token and the channel ID, and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook address (also in Mattermost) or fill in the bot's Token with the channel ID; one of them is enough. Chat commands (in Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in the bot's Token (xoxb-), the app-level Token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: In the LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a Channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot as a friend. The LINE Notify service was closed in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A Token is required only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: go to Apps → Create application, then copy the Token. The server address is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on the iPhone and copy the device key from the example address. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application at pushover.net to get an API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its Webhook address.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the Webhook address. If you chose "Sign" as the security setting, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the Webhook address. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your home server (for example https://matrix.org), the Access token of the sending account, and the ID of the room the account joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google account → Security → 2-step verification → App passwords). Not your regular password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification address of your Apprise API server, for example http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which of its services will receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL address that accepts a JSON POST request with event, title, body and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the address you will get. The old Office 365 connectors were retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space ← Apps and integrations ← Webhooks ← Add Webhook, then copy its address. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration ← Workspace ← Integrations ← New ← Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the Webhook address.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (of type Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key in the form email:key. Target: channel > topic (for example calls > phone), or one or more email addresses for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its Access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, the user name and an app password (settings → security) in the form user:password, and the conversation Token: the last part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: go to Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the Webhook address. On your home network, an http:// address on port 5000 prevents certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your Token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push Token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, without a target. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a Token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public server.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: like smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (for STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The user name is also the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-term access token (profile → security) and the notification service, for example mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under developer tools → actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: On the site ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation shows your key. Create an applet for "Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in gray; with Docker, or for access from outside the home, type an address of your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Using the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After every call the AI writes a short summary. Usually there is no need to set up anything here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any service compatible with OpenAI works, for example an address like https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_model_h.back: For example the model name gpt-4o-mini.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. To use another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is set in a call (a delivery, a meeting), an "Add to calendar" link is attached to the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to set a date, the AI does not agree on the spot; it says it will check and get back to him. Afterwards you click Approve or Decline under "Task to handle" on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you decide, the phone that received the call will send an SMS to the caller (to mobile numbers only). Off: the AI will call him back instead.

console.f_appt_reply.back: The way of replying by default

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: an SMS to a mobile, an AI return call to a landline. Anonymous numbers and numbers that cannot be returned to (abroad, free and the like) get no reply.

console.ar_call.back: Always by an AI return call

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models whose name includes "thinking". A low level answers fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and approve the "Allow USB debugging?" window.

console.ph_offline.back: Not online: disconnect the cable and connect it again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection is active and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off_d.back: The phones connect to Bageo through the network instead.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.usb_none.back: No phone was found on USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add the key so that the AI can talk.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI how callers call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions under "About you" so that the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone is connected right now. See "Phones" on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to receive call summaries to the phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: A Gemini key or another summary service is required.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Dial your phone's number to try.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the call

console.ev_live_ai_start.back: The AI assistant was activated (old menu)

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message reached the time limit

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up while leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not request a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer regarding the way of replying

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer after the contact details were read back

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: The caller said the contact details are wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_contact_confirmed.back: The caller confirmed the contact details

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked to be called back

console.ev_vm_finish_auto_hangup.back: The voicemail ended, the call was disconnected

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.back: The AI failed, moved to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: The AI sent no audio, moved to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI could not be played, moved to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: Came in during another call, was declined as busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or call router: the call was disconnected

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This SMS cannot be sent again: the appointment has not been decided yet, or the SMS was already sent.

console.err_no_calendar.back: This call has no suggestion for the calendar.

console.err_no_audio.back: This call has no recording of this type.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background noise is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The audio file of this background noise is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The sample could not be created. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be saved to the drive.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be carried out.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not know this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: "{field}" must start with http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the Token or the password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or Token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service replied with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem in the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send to this address. Enter the address of your notification service.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be reached.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the web console at the address http://name.local. English letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with the phone camera to open the web console there.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the web console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to the home screen. Next time just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the installation icon to the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some of the old Android devices) will use:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Regular phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone in order to switch the mode from here

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: The AI will no longer answer calls to this phone. It will ring like a regular phone and someone will have to answer. It can be switched back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: Now it is a regular phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: it is possible to switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: The phone is in a call. Try again after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: The phone is still finishing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: The Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU, make sure Bageo Uplink is enabled and then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: The phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: The phone could not change the phone app as the default

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: The phone could not change the call screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: The phone could not change the "Do not disturb" mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: The phone could not turn the ringer back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: The phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: The app on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Refresh this page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: Something went wrong on the phone

console.pill_all_normal.back: All the phones are in regular phone mode

console.er_new.back: Ask the AI to make a call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, handles it and updates you on how it went. During the call you can read the live transcript and guide the AI at any moment.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to find a contact, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: There is no contact by this name. You can also type the number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list, or type a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back:
For example: book a table for 4 for tomorrow at 19:00 under the name Levi, non-smoking; if 19:00 is full, 19:30 to 20:00 is fine too
or: ask which day on the weekend, Friday or Saturday, suits him for dinner
console.er_task_ph.note: fixed: two examples on two lines

console.er_task_h.back: Write what you want done and what is acceptable to you. If the AI is not sure during the call, it will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf, as your assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks in your name as if it were you.

console.er_phone.back: Number from which the call will be made

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line that can dial this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (regular phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in regular phone mode cannot make calls on behalf of the AI. Return it to AI answering on the System page.

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so the AI will not have to stop and ask during the call.

console.er_started.back: Passed to the AI. Dialing now.

console.er_queued.back: In the queue. The AI will call as soon as a phone becomes free.

console.er_empty_title.back: There are no AI errands yet

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs handling. The AI calls, handles it and updates you on the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If there is no answer or the line is busy, it calls again every minute, up to 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Redialing until answered: in attempt {n} there was no answer, will dial again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Dialing, waiting for them to answer…

console.er_watching.back: You are watching: when the AI is not sure, it asks you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will decide on its own

console.er_q_ph.back: Or type an answer of your own

console.er_tell_ph.back: For example: tell them that 20:00 is also fine

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI will end the call immediately. The AI errand may not yet be completed.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other side

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not here, no answer

console.er_ans_timeout.back: No answer was received in time

console.er_options.back: Their options. Choose one and the AI will call back with the answer:

console.er_fu_title.back: Replying and asking the AI to call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will call {who} again and reply with this message.

console.er_delete_b.back: It will be removed from this list. The call records will remain.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: This number does not look valid.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot dial this number (an emergency number, special number or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM that can dial numbers in this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not yet received a call, so the system does not know which SIM cards are in it. Dial it once and try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI needs to handle.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available right now (no phone is connected, or all are in regular phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This AI errand or this contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still in the queue or on the line. Try again after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI cannot pass this on.

console.f_er_identity.back: Calls on behalf of the AI: call as

console.f_er_identity_h.back: The one the AI says it is when it calls on your behalf. In each AI errand you can still choose separately.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: The whitelist (family and friends; can be transferred to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Time-stalling list (the AI stalls their time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you and when. This does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Not answering: transfer directly to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers, and transfers to you if it is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number that the phone dials when something is urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: After it is set, the web console will ask for it when opening (once in each browser). Required for opening the web console from the phone or from another computer.

console.pw_setup_title.back: Setting a password for the web console (optional)

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this web console from outside the home network. You will be able to change it later in the settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. You will be asked to enter it again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must contain at least 8 characters.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_transfer.back: Urgent: an alert was sent to you

console.g_region_d.back: Most people do not need these settings.

console.n_ctl_users_ph_discord.back: User IDs in Discord, for example 123456789012345678

console.n_ctl_users_ph_slack.back: Member IDs in Slack, for example U0123ABCD

console.n_ctl_users_ph_matrix.back: IDs of Matrix users, for example @lee:example.org

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, specify who may give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. In a private message you can leave it empty. For your ID: turn on developer mode, right-click your name → Copy User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, specify who may give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. In a direct message you can leave it empty. For your member ID: open the profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with additional people, specify who may give commands, otherwise no one will be able to. A room in which there is only you and the bot can stay empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, ask the AI to call someone and handle tasks directly from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the list of commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, ask the AI to call someone and handle tasks directly from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the list of commands.

console.k_ai_errand.back: A call on behalf of the AI

console.ev_ai_errand.back: A call on behalf of the AI

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent: you were connected to the call

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: you could not be reached

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI disconnected while dialing you

console.urg_why_merge.back: You could not be connected to the call

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone did not manage to place the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question was already answered or its time has expired.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript and recording will be deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All the calls that ended and their recordings will be deleted permanently. Calls that are currently in progress will remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait for the call to end before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this offline phone from the list. Records of past calls remain.

console.err_device_online.back: First disconnect this phone before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait for the call on this phone to end.

console.ph_sim_num_ph.back: Enter the number of this SIM

console.bl_mode.back: When someone from the blacklist calls:

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choosing the voice of the announcement

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only numbers on the blacklist can end with *, with at least 3 digits before it, without counting leading zeros.

console.sms_search_ph.back: Searching for a sender or content

console.sms_empty_t.back: There are no SMS messages yet

console.sms_empty_d.back: SMS messages that your phones receive will appear here as soon as the SMS forwarding is running.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation, or click "New message".

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send SMS right now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: It is impossible to reply to this sender.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: The app on this phone is too old for sending SMS.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The app on the phone has no permission to send SMS. Allow this on the phone.

console.sms_err_no_service.back: There is no reception on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone did not manage to send the message.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The selected SIM card was not found in the phone.

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls and recordings, SMS messages, AI errands and tasks that are older than this will be deleted automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can connect through Wi-Fi as well

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: Active: a phone that was connected once by USB continues to work through Wi-Fi after the cable is disconnected. Off: phones connect by USB only.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if a phone was lost or if someone else used it.

console.repair_b.back: Phones that are connected by Wi-Fi will be disconnected. Connect each of them by USB one more time to connect it again.

console.repair_done.back: The phones were paired again. Connect each Wi-Fi phone by USB once.

console.g_backup_d.back: Backup files contain your keys and passwords. Keep them in a place to which only you have access.

console.bk_dir_h.back: Leave empty to use the default location. Otherwise type the full path of a folder.

console.bk_calls.back: Include call records, recordings and SMS messages

console.bk_calls_h.back: The backup files will be much larger.

console.bk_files_empty.back: There are no backup files yet.

console.bk_st_none.back: No backup has been made yet.

console.bk_item_contacts.back: Contacts, the blacklist and the whitelist

console.bk_item_numbers.back: Notes on numbers and fraud numbers that you marked

console.bk_warn_newer_version.back: This backup was created in a newer version of Bageo. Some of the settings might not work here.

console.bk_warn_plain_settings_file.back: This is a regular settings file, so only the settings will be restored.

console.bk_warn_password.back: The web console password will change to the password in this backup.

console.bk_dlg_note.back: Before the restore, Bageo saves your current settings in a separate file.

console.bk_done_apply.back: Restored. Your previous settings were saved under the name {name}.

console.bk_done_restart.back: Reopen Bageo so that everything takes effect.

console.err_backup_dir_unwritable.back: It is impossible to save in this folder. Choose a different folder and type its full path.

console.bk_err_busy.back: A backup or restore is already in progress at the moment. Try again when they finish.

console.bk_err_dir_unwritable.back: It is impossible to save in the backup folder. Choose a different folder.

console.bk_err_disk_full.back: The drive is full. Free up space or choose a different folder.

console.bk_err_io.back: The backup did not succeed. Try again in a moment.

console.bk_err_not_backup.back: This is not a Bageo backup file. Choose a different file.

console.bk_err_damaged.back: This backup file is corrupted. Try a different file.

console.bk_err_too_new.back: This backup comes from a newer version of Bageo. First install the newer version.

console.bk_err_too_large.back: The file is larger than 200 MB. Use a settings-only backup.

console.bk_err_expired.back: This took too long. Choose the file again.

console.bk_err_call_active.back: There is an active call right now. Try again when it ends.

console.bk_err_not_local.back: It is possible to open the folder only on the computer that runs Bageo.

console.bk_exp_title.back: What would you like to export?

console.bk_exp_keys_h.back: Check this when you move to another computer. Leave it off when you show your settings to someone.

console.bk_warn_keys_kept.back: The keys, passwords and connections on this computer will remain as they are.

console.bk_warn_connections.back: The notification destinations and those authorized to control Bageo remotely will change to what is written in this file.

console.bk_err_need_password.back: To download the file, open the web console on the computer that runs Bageo, or first set a password for the web console.

console.bk_err_bad_request.back: Something is wrong in the file or in the request. Choose the file again and try again.

console.bk_err_not_found.back: This backup file is no longer there. Refresh the page and choose a different file.

console.bk_encrypt_h.back: Protects the copies that you keep on an external drive, in a cloud folder or in a network folder.

console.bk_pw_h.back: If you forget the password, it will be impossible to open these backups, and Bageo will not be able to recover them either.

console.bk_exp_enc.back: Encrypting this file with a password
